activities.name: Musée du Louvre
activities.description: The world's largest art museum and a historic monument, housing works such as the Mona Lisa and the Venus de Milo.

activities.name: Musée d'Orsay
activities.location: 1 Rue de la Légion d'Honneur, 75007 Paris
activities.description: Museum housed in a former railway station, famous for holding the largest collection of impressionist and post-impressionist masterpieces.

activities.name: Centre Pompidou
activities.description: Complex building housing the National Museum of Modern Art, known for its high-tech architecture with external pipes and escalators.

activities.name: Musée de l'Orangerie
activities.description: Art gallery of impressionist and post-impressionist paintings, most notably famous for housing eight Water Lilies murals by Claude Monet.

activities.name: Musée Rodin
activities.description: Museum that showcases the works of the French sculptor Auguste Rodin, featuring sculptures inside an 18th-century mansion and its expansive gardens.

activities.name: Musée Picasso Paris
activities.description: Art museum dedicated to the life and works of the Spanish artist Pablo Picasso, located in the historic Hôtel Salé.

activities.name: Musée Carnavalet
activities.description: Museum dedicated to the history of Paris, from its prehistoric origins up to the modern day, situated in two neighboring mansions.

activities.name: Musée Yves Saint Laurent Paris
activities.description: Museum dedicated to the work of fashion designer Yves Saint Laurent, housed in the historic fashion house where he created his designs.

activities.name: Musée de Cluny
activities.description: National museum of the Middle Ages, known for its extensive collection of medieval artifacts including the famous Lady and the Unicorn tapestries.

activities.name: Palais de Tokyo
activities.description: Building dedicated to modern and contemporary art, featuring rotating installations, exhibitions, and performances.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower
activities.location: Champ de Mars, 5 Av. Anatole France, 75007 Paris
activities.description: Iconic wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars, offering panoramic views of the city from its observation decks.

activities.name: Seine River Cruise
activities.location: Bateaux Parisiens, Port de la Bourdonnais, 75007 Paris
activities.description: Scenic boat tour along the River Seine passing under historic bridges and past major Parisian monuments.

activities.name: Sainte-Chapelle
activities.description: Royal chapel in Gothic style, renowned for its stunning collection of stained-glass windows depicting biblical scenes.

activities.name: Luxembourg Gardens
activities.description: Popular public park created in the 17th century, featuring tree-lined promenades, lawns, tennis courts, and the Medici Fountain.

activities.name: Montmartre Walking Tour
activities.description: Self-guided walk through the hilly artistic district of Montmartre, winding past cobbled streets, historic cafes, and the Sacré-Cœur.

food.name: Le Comptoir de la Relais
food.description: Renowned neighborhood bistro serving traditional local French comfort food in a lively, casual atmosphere.

food.name: Bouillon Chartier
food.description: Historic Belle Époque brasserie offering classic French local dishes at affordable prices in a cavernous, ornate dining room.

food.name: Café de Flore
food.description: Famous historic cafe on Saint-Germain-des-Prés, known for its literary history, sidewalk seating, and traditional coffee and pastries.

food.name: Les Deux Magots
food.description: Iconic café frequented by famous intellectuals and artists, serving traditional French breakfast items, hot chocolate, and local bistro snacks.

food.name: Au Pied de Cochon
food.description: Traditional 24-hour brasserie near Châtelet serving hearty, classic French local pork dishes and seafood platters.

food.name: Breizh Café
food.description: Popular creperie in the Marais serving artisanal Breton buckwheat galettes and sweet crepes made with high-quality local ingredients.

food.name: Le Procope
food.description: Claimed to be the oldest continuously operating restaurant in Paris, serving historic French local cuisine in an opulent 18th-century setting.

food.name: L'As du Fallafel
food.description: Famous Middle Eastern eatery in the historic Jewish quarter of the Marais, popular for its bustling takeaway window and falafel pita.

food.name: Bistrot Paul Bert
food.description: Quintessential Parisian bistro known for its retro decor, traditional steak frites, and classic Grand Marnier soufflé.

food.name: Du Pain et des Idées
food.description: Renowned artisanal bakery in an old-world setting, famous for its escargot pastries and traditional loaves.

food.name: Pierre Hermé Paris
food.description: High-end pastry shop renowned for its inventive macaron flavors and exquisite sweet creations.

accommodation.name: Generator Paris
accommodation.description: Trendy design hostel offering both shared dorms and private rooms, featuring a lively rooftop bar and social areas.

accommodation.name: CitizenM Paris Gare de Lyon
accommodation.description: Contemporary tech-forward hotel with compact, mood-lit rooms and a 24-hour rooftop cloud M bar overlooking the city.

accommodation.name: Saint Christopher's Inn Paris Canal
accommodation.description: Lively waterfront hostel located right by the Bassin de la Villette, featuring an attached bar and outdoor terrace.

shopping.name: Galeries Lafayette Haussmann
shopping.description: Famed upscale department store featuring a magnificent neo-Byzantine stained-glass dome and floors of luxury fashion brands.

shopping.name: Le Bon Marché
shopping.description: The world's oldest department store, offering an elite selection of designer fashion, beauty products, and gourmet foods.

shopping.name: Printemps Haussmann
shopping.description: Major department store dedicated to French fashion, luxury brands, beauty, and home design under historic stained-glass ceilings.

shopping.name: Marais Boutiques District
shopping.description: Trendy historic district filled with independent fashion designers, vintage stores, and concept clothing boutiques.

shopping.name: Champs-Élysées
shopping.description: Famous avenue lined with international flagship fashion retailers, luxury car showrooms, cinemas, and cafes.

shopping.name: BHV Marais
shopping.description: Historic department store focusing on fashion, home improvement, DIY, hardware, and creative design supplies.

shopping.name: Rue de Rivoli
shopping.description: Long historic shopping street featuring continuous arcades, filled with popular fast-fashion apparel brands and souvenir shops.

shopping.name: Palais Royal Arcades
shopping.description: Covered historical arcades surrounding the Palais Royal garden, housing exclusive vintage fashion, perfume, and art boutiques.

shopping.name: Forum des Halles
shopping.description: Large multi-level subterranean and open-air shopping mall featuring numerous popular clothing brands and beauty shops.

shopping.name: Beaugrenelle Paris
shopping.description: Modern department store and shopping mall complex near the Seine featuring contemporary fashion brands and lifestyle stores.

shopping.name: Rue Saint-Honoré
shopping.description: Historic and upscale shopping street known for trendy concept stores, luxury fashion boutiques, and fine leather goods.

shopping.name: Marché aux Puces de Saint-Ouen
shopping.description: Massive and historic flea market on the northern edge of Paris known for antique furniture, vintage fashion, and collectibles.

shopping.name: Shakespeare and Company Bookstore
shopping.description: World-famous independent English-language bookstore facing the Seine, known for its literary history and cozy nooks.

filtered_out.description: Legendary traditional Parisian bistro famed for its old-school interior, generous portions of local French delicacies, and roasted meats.

filtered_out.name: Septime
filtered_out.description: Acclaimed contemporary neo-bistro serving inventive, seasonal dishes rooted in local French culinary traditions.

filtered_out.name: Le Jules Verne

filtered_out.name: The Hoxton Paris
